product_hub_desc: Everything your store sells starts here. Build your catalog, set prices, and keep your offerings sharp.
product_catalog_desc: Browse, search, and manage every product in your store.
departments_desc: Group your products into departments and sub-departments for cleaner reporting.
discounts_promos_desc: Create deals, happy hours, and volume discounts to drive sales.
schedules_desc: Set time-based pricing and availability for seasonal or hourly items.
tax_rules_desc: Define tax rates and apply them to the right products and transactions.
brands_sizes_desc: Organize products by brand and manage size variants in one place.
modifiers_desc: Add-ons, flavors, extras — let customers customize their orders.
bulk_editor_desc: Update prices, categories, or attributes across hundreds of items at once.
